loadError.title: Couldn't load this application
loadError.text: Check your connection and try again.

approveText: Their role becomes Farmer and a stall panel opens on their account. They keep every customer feature they have now. Nothing appears to shoppers until they add products and set a pickup window.

fromCustomer.title: This application comes from an account that already shops on MarketLink.
fromCustomer.text: Approving turns the same account into a stall; no second account is created. They keep every customer feature they have now.

suspendedBanner.title: This stall is suspended.
suspendedBanner.text: Its products stay hidden from customers. Orders already placed still run their course.

photos.title: Photos of the plot
photos.hint: Check that the plot in the photos looks like the pin on the map and grows what the applicant listed. You are not checking licences, food safety or organic claims.

stall.title: The stall they are asking for
stall.name: Stall name

map: The plot and the market they want to sell at

approval.title: What approval does
approval.text: Their role becomes Farmer and a stall panel opens. They keep buying from other stalls with the same account. Nothing is listed until they add products and set a pickup window.
